title: Hunter Green Account: ATM Fees and Out-of-Network Usage
summary: This document explains Hunter Green Account fees for ATM cash withdrawals: $2.00 per domestic out-of-network (non‑Rho) ATM transaction, and international ATM fees of 2.5% of the withdrawal amount (minimum $4.00). Non‑Rho international withdrawals may include both fees, plus any ATM owner/operator surcharges. Eligible out-of-network ATM fees are automatically rebated up to $20 per month, with fees/rebates shown as separate line items.
